safe_output_scope: The exact program writes only an adjacent receipt; executing an unchanged owned copy keeps its receipt in this folder. Original source path is not executed.
runtime_scope: Existing isolated Python runtime and installed python-flint; no installation or network. -B disables bytecode writes, not assertions; no -O/-OO.
rough_duration: Historical runtime metadata indicated about648seconds; no archived mathematical result adopted.
known_receipt_semantics: Program writes an intermediate receipt before all gates; completion requires actual exit0 and full_finite_gates pass with complete coverage; failures are retained.
